Original Attribute Definition:
The time interval between the impact of the striker or firing pin on the primer, and a rise in
pressure sufficient to start the bullet from its seated position in the cartridge case. The elapsed
time from the moment of firing pin contact on the primer to the point on the x (time) axis equal to
the point where the pressure-time curve indicates propellant burning has initiated.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A time interval between the impact of a striker or firing pin on a cartridge primer, and a rise in pressure sufficient to start a bullet from its seated position in a cartridge case.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
Marks produced by the random imperfections or irregularities of tool surfaces. These random
imperfections or irregularities are produced incidental to manufacture and/or caused by use,
corrosion, or damage. They are unique to that tool to the practical exclusion of all other tools.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
(1) Toolmarks known to have been made by different tools.
(2) Toolmarks produced by the same tool but deliberately placed in a non-matching position.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A description of any toolmarks known to have been made by different tools, or toolmarks produced by the same tool but deliberately placed in a non-matching position.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The amount of energy delivered to the primer from the firing pin blow.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: An amount of energy delivered to a primer from a firing pin blow.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The time interval between sear release and the firing pin striking the primer.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A time interval between sear release and the firing pin striking the primer.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
(1) A secure storage place for gunpowder, ammunition, or explosives.
(2) A container for cartridges which has a spring and follower to feed those cartridges into
the chamber of a firearm. The magazine may be detachable or an integral part of the
firearm.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A kind of magazine used in a firearm.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
A method used to measure ammunition and/or firearm accuracy capability. To determine the
mean radius, the center of the group is located and the distance to the center of each shot from the group center is measured and recorded. The sum of these measurements divided by the number of shots is the mean radius.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
An angular measurement method used to describe accuracy capability. A minute of angle is one sixtieth of a degree. It subtends 1.047 inches at 100 yards, which for practical shooting purposes
is considered to be one inch. A minute of angle group, therefore, equals one inch at 100 yards,
two inches at 200 yards, etc. At 8” for example, it is approximately .002”.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A value for one of 100 equal parts of a minute of angle.
Status: Mapped to existing NIEMOpen attribute.

Original Attribute Definition: Any angle other than perpendicular or parallel.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
(1) For a firearm, it is the dimension measured parallel to the axis of the bore from the
muzzle to a line at a right angle to the axis and tangent to the rearmost point of the butt
plate or grip.
(2) For ammunition, it is the greatest dimension of a loaded cartridge. For centerfire and
rimfire cartridges, it is the measurement from the face of the head to the tip of the bullet.
For shotshells or blanks, it is the measurement from the face of the head to the crimp.
Overall length does not refer to the uncrimped length of a shotshell.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: For a firearm, the dimension measured parallel to the axis of the bore from the muzzle to a line at a right angle to the axis and tangent to the rearmost point of the butt plate or grip. For ammunition, the greatest dimension of a loaded cartridge.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
The distance a part travels after a particular event occurs in the normal operation of the firearm
(e.g., the rearward motion of the trigger after the sear or hammer release or the rearward motion of
a bolt beyond ejection, etc.).
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The force developed in a firearm by the expanding gases generated by the combustion of the propellant.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A force developed in a firearm by the expanding gases generated by the combustion of a propellant.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The arithmetic mean of a number of cartridges tested for pressure.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The arithmetic mean of a number of cartridges tested for pressure.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The pressure in a firearm generated by the expanding propellant gases after ignition. Normally measured by means of piezoelectric transducers or crusher gauges. Also known as breech pressure or barrel pressure.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Amount of pressure in a firearm generated by the expanding propellant gases after ignition.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The highest value that the chamber pressure reaches during the burning of propellant.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The pressure level that remains in the cartridge case or shotshell within the firearm’s chamber and in the bore immediately after the projectile leaves the muzzle of the firearm.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Applies only to gas operated firearms. The amount of pressure remaining in the bore as the bullet passes the gas port. If port pressures are too high, damage can result from the violent cycling of the action. It is important to understand that this can occur even when chamber pressures are within acceptable limits. Port pressure can be controlled by proper powder selection.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
Relates to firearm discharge pressure measured by a copper crusher testing system. These values
provide a means of testing and evaluating peak pressure generated during the discharge of a
suitably modified firearm. Abbreviated: C.U.P.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Amount of firearm discharge pressure measured by a copper crusher testing system, used to provide a means of testing and evaluating peak pressure generated during the discharge of a suitably modified firearm.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: A stamp applied to a firearm after it has passed a proof test.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
A numerical tabulation of CMS runs. Typically, the number of CMS is designated by a number,
followed by the letter x (e.g., 2x, 3x, etc.).
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A numerical tabulation of CMS runs, typically designated by a number, followed by the letter x (e.g., 2x, 3x, etc.).
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: Results of toolmark comparison, including objective observations that support the findings of toolmark examinations. Possible conclusions include: identification, inconclusive, elimination, and unsuitable
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Results of toolmark comparison, including objective observations that support the findings of toolmark examinations. Possible conclusions include: identification, inconclusive, elimination, and unsuitable.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.
Comments: JS: This concept is not specific to the cbrn domain. A NIEM core or Forensics element would be better.

Original Attribute Definition:
The force of the firearm’s movement opposite to the direction of the bullet, usually expressed in
foot-pounds (ft-lbs) or joules (J).
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Category of mechanism in which the force of recoil is used to unlock the breech bolt and then to complete the cycle of extracting, ejecting, and reloading.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
Helical grooves cut or impressed into the bore of a firearm barrel to impart rotary motion to a
projectile when fired.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
The angle at which the rifling is cut in relationship to the axis of the bore. It is usually stated as
the number of inches required for one revolution, for example one turn in 12 inches. Also known
as rate of twist.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
The direction (right or left) and rate at which the rifling of the firearm turns within the bore. This
is normally expressed as the distance required for the rifling (and projectile) to make one complete
revolution. Depending on the origin of the firearm, this may be written in inches or in millimeters (e.g., 1 turn in 12 inches or 1 turn in 305 mm).
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Category of manual safety mechanism for a firearm (ex: cross bolt, grip, lever, etc.)
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: A number applied to a weapon for identification purposes.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: An identifier for an individual weapon.
Status: Mapped to existing NIEMOpen attribute.

Original Attribute Definition: An object propelled by external force and continuing in motion by its own inertia (e.g., a bullet propelled from a firearm by the force of rapidly burning gases or other means).
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The ability of a projectile to dissipate its kinetic energy effectively into a target.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: A numerical term indicating the general profile of a projectile.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A numerical term indicating the general profile of a projectile.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The maximum distance at which a projectile can be expected to be useful in its intended purpose.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A distance along a specific line from a known or observed point within which a system or platform can operate effectively, in the range 1 through 99999 or in the range 0.1 through 999.9.
Status: Mapped to existing NIEMOpen attribute.

Original Attribute Definition:
The capacity of a projectile to do work in flight. The units are typically expressed as foot-pounds,
joules, or kilogram-meters. Also known as projectile energy.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The capacity of a projectile to do work in flight, expressed in  foot-pounds, joules, or kilogram-meters; also known as projectile energy.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The energy of a fired projectile(s) measured at the muzzle of a firearm.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The energy of a projectile(s) measured at the point of impact.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
The force placed on an object by the atmosphere in opposition to forward motion. Also known as
aerodynamic drag.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The amount of aerodynamic drag force placed on an object by the atmosphere in opposition to forward motion.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
The effect on velocity, and therefore projectile trajectory and shot pattern, caused by changes in
atmospheric density due to altitude.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A data object used to measure the effect of altitude on firing results.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
The greatest distance a projectile can travel when fired at the optimum angle of elevation of the
barrel. Also known as extreme range.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The rate of spin of a projectile fired from a rifled barrel.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A rotational speed in seconds per revolution (SPR), in the range 0 through 99999 or any combination of four or fewer digits and a significant decimal point (pt). There is a 5-character maximum (max).
Status: Mapped to existing NIEMOpen attribute.

Original Attribute Definition: The total elapsed time that a projectile requires to travel a specific distance from the muzzle.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A time that a projectile takes to travel from the weapon to the target (time of flight), expressed to the nearest tenth of a second.
Status: Mapped to existing NIEMOpen attribute.

Original Attribute Definition: A non-spherical projectile for use in a rifled barrel
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A non-spherical projectile for use in a rifled barrel.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: Category of bullet for a particular firearm
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A kind of bullet for a particular firearm.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The maximum dimension across the largest cylindrical section of a bullet.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A measure of the maximum dimension across the largest cylindrical section of a bullet.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
The distance that a bullet must travel from its position at rest in the cartridge case to its initial
engagement with the rifling of the barrel. Also known as free travel.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The distance that a bullet must travel from its position at rest in the cartridge case to its initial engagement with the rifling of the barrel; also known as free travel.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The distance which a projectile travels in a target material.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The distance which a bullet travels in a target material.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The force required to pull a bullet from the case mouth. Also referred to as neck tension.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The force required to pull a bullet from the case mouth; also referred to as neck tension.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The force required to shorten a cartridge by pushing on the bullet.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The force required to shorten a cartridge by pushing on the bullet.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: Any method that will allow the recovery of a fired, undamaged bullet. Different systems are needed for various cartridges depending on bullet composition, jacket thickness, and velocity. Water tanks and cotton boxes are most commonly used.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Method used that will allow the recovery of a fired, undamaged bullet.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The cutting of metal from a bullet due to a cylinder misalignment in a revolver. Also known as shaving.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A description of the cutting of metal from a bullet due to a cylinder misalignment in a revolver; also known as shaving.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The rotational motion imparted to a bullet by the rifling in the barrel.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Measurement of the rotational motion imparted to a bullet by the rifling in the barrel.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
The spatter and fragmentation of a bullet upon impacting a hard surface. Also known as lead
splash.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Measurement of the area of spatter and fragmentation of a bullet upon impacting a hard surface; also known as lead splash.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: Elongation of the bullet during firing.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Description of any elongation of a bullet that occurred during firing.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
(1) In interior ballistics, it is the change of a bullet’s form due to chamber pressure.
(2) In exterior ballistics, it is the expansion of a bullet upon impact with target.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Description of a change in a bullet's form due to chamber pressure or upon impact with a target.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
An instability caused by the eccentricity or imbalance of the bullet in flight. Yaw is usually the
greatest in the initial portion of its flight in the atmosphere after which the bullet “goes to sleep”
and becomes fully spin-stabilized. Yaw may also occur after an elongated bullet strikes an object
or when it enters media other than the atmosphere. Also known as bullet tipping or bullet wobble.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A measure of the instability caused by the eccentricity or imbalance of a bullet in flight; also known as bullet tipping or bullet wobble.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
The deviation in flight of a bullet from the center line of the bore due to the gyrational spin of the
bullet imparted by the rifling.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The deviation in flight of a bullet from the center line of the bore due to the gyrational spin of the bullet imparted by the rifling.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The ratio of the weight of a bullet in pounds to the square root of its diameter in inches.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The ratio of the weight of a bullet in pounds to the square root of its diameter in inches.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The common name for the spherical projectiles loaded into shotshells. Also known as shot.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Category of shot for a particular shotshell
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The length of the shot load in a shotshell.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
A numerical or letter(s) designation indicating the average diameter of a pellet. The Rule of 17 is
an equation that can be applied to American, numerical shot sizes to determine the average shot diameter in hundredths of an inch.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The diameter of a shot pattern.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The speed of a projectile at a given point along its trajectory.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A measure of the rate of change of position along a straight line with respect to time.
Status: Mapped to existing NIEMOpen attribute.

Original Attribute Definition: The velocity of a projectile(s) that is recorded by suitable instrumentation located at a predetermined distance from the muzzle of a test barrel or a firearm.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A measure of the velocity of a projectile that is recorded by suitable instrumentation located at a predetermined distance from the muzzle of a test barrel or a firearm.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The velocity of a projectile as it exits the muzzle of a firearm
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The velocity of a projectile at any point of its trajectory.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The velocity of a projectile upon impact.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The velocity of a projectile at the highest point of the trajectory.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: In small arms ballistics, it is the constant speed of a projectile after air drag and gravitation pull have reached the point where the two forces cancel each other’s effect on the projectile
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The distance between the centers of the two shots which are the farthest apart in a group of shots on a target.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A measurement of the distance between the centers of the two shots which are the farthest apart in a group of shots on a target.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: Distance between the muzzle of a weapon and the target
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
The wood or plastic component(s) to which the metal parts of a firearm are attached to enable the
shooter to hold the firearm.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Category of stock for a particular firearm
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
General stock dimensions consist of the following: cast, drop at comb, drop at Monte Carlo, drop
at heel, girth, length of pull and pitch.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The lateral displacement of the centerline of the buttplate (pad) from the centerline of the bore.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The lateral displacement of the centerline of a firearm's buttplate or pad from the centerline of the bore.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The vertical distance from the line of sight to the comb, Monte Carlo, or heel of the stock.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The vertical distance from the line of sight to the comb, Monte Carlo, or heel of the stock.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The smallest circumferential dimension at the pistol grip.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A measurement of the smallest circumferential dimension at the pistol grip.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The distance from the center of the trigger to the center of the buttplate or recoil pad.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A measure of the distance from the center of a firearm's trigger to the center of the buttplate or recoil pad.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The greatest dimension of the stock material.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A measure of the greatest dimension of a firearm's stock material.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: An expression used to indicate the relationship of the bore to the plane of the buttplate (pad).
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Features that may be produced during manufacture that are consistent among items fabricated by the same tool in the same approximate state of wear. These features are not determined prior to manufacture and are more restrictive than class characteristics.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
The lowest temperature to which the surface of material must be raised for the combustion of the
material to become self-sustaining.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A measure of the lowest temperature at which a hazardous material can form an ignitable mixture in air.
Status: Mapped to existing NIEMOpen attribute.

Original Attribute Definition: The part of a firearm mechanism that is moved manually to cause the firearm to discharge.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Category of trigger for a particular firearm
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
The initial distance the trigger moves prior to sear movement. Also known as pretravel and trigger
slack.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The amount of force which must be applied to the trigger of a firearm to cause sear release
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
Toolmark identification is a discipline of forensic science which has as its primary concern to
determine if a toolmark was produced by a particular tool.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Information describing contour variations on the surface of an object caused by a combination of force and motion where the motion of the tool is approximately perpendicular to the plane being marked.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A description of contour variations on the surface of an object caused by a combination of force and motion, where the motion of the tool is approximately perpendicular to the plane being marked.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: Information describing contour variations, generally microscopic, on the surface of an object caused by a combination of force and motion where the motion of the tool is approximately parallel to the plane being marked.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
A line on each of two mating parts which must be an extension of each other when assembled to
indicate proper alignment. Also known as draw mark, draw line, or witness mark.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A description of a line on each of two mating parts which must be an extension of each other when assembled to indicate proper alignment.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
An object used to gain mechanical advantage. Also thought of as the harder of two objects which,
when brought into contact with each other, results in the softer object being marked by the harder object.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A kind of tool.
Status: Mapped to existing NIEMOpen attribute.

Original Attribute Definition:
A striated or impressed toolmark produced by the suspect tool which is to be used in making a
comparison with the evidence mark.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The total residues resulting from the discharge of a firearm. It includes both gunpowder and primer residues, plus metallic residues from projectiles, fouling, etc.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The total residues resulting from the discharge of a firearm. It includes both gunpowder and primer residues, plus metallic residues from projectiles, fouling, etc.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: A term describing the shattering power of high explosives.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Measure of the shattering power of high explosives.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
The discolored area on the immediate periphery of a bullet hole, caused by the transfer of residues
from the bearing surface of the bullet.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Description of the discolored area on the immediate periphery of a bullet hole, caused by the transfer of residues from the bearing surface of the bullet.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: Information about tests performed related to firearms and toolmarks
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Any of various powders used as the propellant in a cartridge or shotshell
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A kind of gunpowder used as the propellant in a cartridge or shotshell.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: The spatial distribution of gunpowder residues deposited upon a surface.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A description of the spatial distribution of gunpowder residues deposited upon a surface.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
A chemical used to retard or stop an undesirable reaction. In the manufacture of powder
propellants it is used to retard the burning rate.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A chemical used to retard or stop an undesirable reaction.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: Gunpowder residue left in firearms after firing.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
The components of gunshot residue which contain elements which were originally part of the
primer mixture of a cartridge. The scanning electron microscope (SEM) with energy dispersive
X-Ray are used to analyze for some of the elements in primer residue, such as antimony, barium, and lead. Other methods that have been used for analyzing the elements of primer residue are neutron activation analysis (NAA) and atomic absorption (AA).
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: A chemical used to react with another chemical, often to confirm or deny the presence of the second chemical.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A chemical used to react with another chemical, often to confirm or deny the presence of the second chemical.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
The portion of gunpowder residue which consists essentially of carbon and leaves a black deposit
on a target surface when the muzzle of the firearm is very close to the target. Also known as
sooting and smudging.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
The application of scientific techniques used for the retrieval, recovery, and/or revisualization of
the manufacturer’s identifier
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: An additional manufacturer’s applied serial number not in plain view.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: An additional manufacturer’s applied serial number not in plain view.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition: Method used to obliterate the serial number
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
Any unique designation placed on an object by an owner, purchaser, or user for identification or
proof of ownership.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
Permanent change in the shape or size of a solid body without fracture resulting from the
application of a sustained stress beyond the elastic limit. May also be referred to as permanent
deformation.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: method used by the manufacturer to apply the serial number
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Method used to restore the serial number
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Result of serial number restoration; possible values are "full restoration", "partial restoration", and "no restoration"
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Information related to a sight or scope associated with a firearm
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Category of structures or devices, mechanical or optical, designed to assist in aiming a firearm at a target.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: Category of an optical sight consisting of a series of lenses and a reticle which magnify a target and increase a shooter's accuracy in aiming; a terrestrial telescope equipped with a reticle that is superimposed on the field of view and automatically focuses on the image.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
The vertical distance a bullet has fallen, under the influence of gravity, at any point in its flight
path. The distance is measured from a point on its path to the straight line from the axis of the
bore to target.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The vertical distance a bullet has fallen, under the influence of gravity, at any point in its flight path; Measured from a point on its path to the straight line from the axis of the bore to target.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
The distance between a shooter’s eye and the ocular lens of a telescopic sight required for an
optimum field of view (FOV). Distance usually exceeds three inches. Also known as eye distance
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A measurement of the distance between a shooter’s eye and the ocular lens of a telescopic sight required for an optimum field of view (FOV).
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
The widest dimension visible through a telescopic sight, measured in feet seen at a range of 100
yards. Field of View (FOV) decreases as the magnification power of a scope increases.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A narrow field of view reported in kilometers.
Status: Mapped to existing NIEMOpen attribute.

Original Attribute Definition:
The best possible enlargement of an image seen through a scope, obtained when the exit pupil is
equal in diameter to the pupil of a shooter’s eye.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The clarity or freedom from distortion of an image transmitted through a scope.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: The clarity or freedom from distortion of an image transmitted through a scope.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.
Comments: JS: This concept is not specific to the cbrn domain. A NIEM core or Forensics element would be better.

Original Attribute Definition: The distance between the rear sight and the front sight on a firearm.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: A device which reduces muzzle blast by decreasing the velocity of escaping gases but maintains a bullet’s high velocity.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition: The complete collection of baffles that make up the interior of a suppressor.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A description of the system of baffles that make up the interior of a suppressor.
Status: Initial refinement completed. Pending Tiger Team review.

Original Attribute Definition:
A series of baffles designed to restrict the passage of gas generated during the discharge of a
firearm.

Original Attribute Definition:
Components of a suppressor - usually discs, washers, wafers, or some other material. These
components can be made of metal, rubber, cork, leather, or plastic and can be conical, flat, or
spiral in shape.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: Component(s) of a suppressor designed to restrict the passage of gas generated during the discharge of a firearm.

Original Attribute Definition: Equivalent continuous sound pressure level, or Leq, is the constant noise level that would result in the same total sound energy being produced over a given period.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
A sound level that is maintained for a one second interval and is equivalent to the total acoustic
energy generated by the measured noise.
Status: Needs to be refined by Tiger Team.

Original Attribute Definition:
The measure of variation in atmospheric pressure resulting in a sound level to which the ear
responds. Measured by a sound level meter in decibels.
NIEM Equivalent/ Refined Attribute Defin: A maximum difference between the actual pressure at any point in the field of a sound wave at any instant and the average pressure at that point detected by remote ground sensor strings measured in decibels.
Status: Mapped to existing NIEMOpen attribute.
